text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al- Sabah hospitalised after suffering sudden health problem. Kuwait says Sheikh Saad's health condition "extremely reassuring".
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah says Kuwait's support for Lebanon and Syria is firm. The emir on Tuesday received Lebanese parliament speaker Nabih Berri.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index sets a new record, rising 20.7 points to 2,218.8.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah sends a message to Qatari counterpart Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani.
- Kuwait's emir holds talks with visiting Congo President Pascal Lissouba.
- Kuwait grants the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) $500,000. A cheque with the amount was handed to the ICRC in Geneva.
